- If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) over recent days, model tends to under-forecast; adjust upward by 1–3% for next period.  
- If sentiment is negative (≤0.33) or volatile, model often over-forecasts; reduce forecast by 1–4% to align with mean reversion.  
- After sharp price spikes (e.g., >5% from prior day), model frequently overshoots; cap forecast at +2–3% above peak for next 3–5 days.  
- If sentiment shifts from positive to negative mid-horizon, model may lag; add 0.5–1.5% downward correction in final 5–7 days.  
- Model shows strong mean reversion bias in 30d horizon; if forecast is >1.5% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 0.5–1.0% unless sentiment supports continuation.
